blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: VLMs for medical image interpretation are typically evaluated on clean inputs, despite the progressive evidence loss that can occur in high stakes clinical settings. Existing robustness studies show that performance can degrade while confidence remains high, but do not establish when a previously reliable model-case pair ceases to behave reliably. We introduce a baseline-anchored framework that traces baseline-correct cases through progressive image degradation to identify an empirical evidence boundary, and define mirage as continued commitment at this boundary, regardless of correctness. Across three VLMs on three medical datasets, only MedGemma provides a sufficiently large baseline-correct pool for trajectory analysis. On VQA-RAD, the only dataset in which the question text varies, language-only answerability is associated with baseline correctness (AUROC 0.677) and with commitment at the boundary (AUROC 0.653 to 0.670). MedGemma's post-boundary behavior is heterogeneous, including direct mirage, correct recovery, mirage dissolution, consistent abstention, and oscillation, with mirage rates of 16.0 to 100.0% across dataset-modality pairs. Despite this behavioral heterogeneity, residual-stream probes decode commit-versus-abstain behavior at the boundary with AUROC of 0.895 to 0.994 under nested cross-validation. These results show that progressive evidence loss can produce persistent commitment that output entropy and abstention behavior do not consistently reflect, motivating boundary-aware evaluation, option-order controls, and improved abstention mechanisms for reliable medical foundation models operating under partial observation.
blocks.zh: 用于医疗图像判读的VLM通常以清洁输入值来评价,尽管在高赌注的临床环境中可能会发生渐进的证据损失。 现有的强性研究表明,性能在信心保持高的同时会下降,但并不确定之前可靠的模型对何时停止可靠行为. 我们采用了一个基线确定框架,通过图像逐步退化来追踪基线正确案例,以确定经验证据边界,并将海市定义为这一边界的持续承诺,无论正确与否。 在三个医疗数据集的3个VLM中,只有MedGemma为轨迹分析提供了足够大的基线正确集合. 在VQA-RAD上,问题文本变化的唯一数据集,只有语言的可答性与基线正确性(AUROC 0.677)和边界承诺(AUROC 0.653至0.670)有关. MedGemma的后边界行为是多种多样的,包括直接海市,正确的恢复,海市解体,一贯的弃权,以及振荡,跨数据集模式对的海市利率为16.0%至100.0%. 尽管有这种行为异质性,但残余流探测器在嵌入式交叉验证下与AUROC的边界0.895至0.994发生解码-对吸收行为. 这些结果表明,逐步丧失证据可产生持续的承诺,即输出的py和弃权行为不能始终如一地反映、激励边界意识评估、选择令控制以及改进在部分观察下运作的可靠医疗基础模型的弃权机制。

blocks.en: Figure 5 : IDK (abstention) rate by ground-truth class and severity for MedGemma across each dataset-modality pair. Color encodes the percentage of examples in that class abstaining at that severity level, and labels are rounded to integers. HAM10000 panels show a uniformly low IDK rate across all classes and severities, consistent with the main text’s finding that HAM10000 almost never abstains under image degradation (see “Class-level trajectories” in Appendix K). APTOS and VQA-RAD panels show class-dependent onset of abstention, complementing the aggregate class-level breakdowns discussed in the main text.
